notes: No official register of clinics (DVS/MVC) with public contact data was found; the MSAVA member list is the main roster. Refused or empty: gasingvet.com and uvh.upm.edu.my / upm.edu.my (robots), vetessential.com contact page (robots), animalhospital.com.my subpages (empty). Provenance blocked fetches of many clinic sites not returned by search (Kota Damansara, Petaling Jaya and Penang clinics, Langkawi LAMC, Pets City JB, St Angel own site). Not covered: Putrajaya, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, most of Perak, Kedah beyond two clinics; Kelantan/Terengganu thin. Other Klang Valley 24 h clinics named by aggregators (Gasing, St Angel, Pets City JB, Dom's Pet & Care) need own pages before being marked 24 h. No duty rotas and no animal poison line found (National Poison Centre USM is for humans). Hours for MSAVA-only entries are unknown.
